name: card_heading
label: Card Heading
help_text: Heading displayed at the top of the enquiry form card.

name: heading_level
label: Heading Level
help_text: Controls the HTML heading tag. Use H1 only once per page for the main title.

name: service_name
label: Service Name (Meta)
help_text: Service name shown in the meta block above the form (e.g. 'Mortgage Broking').

name: service_tier
label: Tier (Meta)
help_text: Tier shown in the meta block (e.g. 'Bronze+').

name: service_availability
label: Availability (Meta)
help_text: Availability shown in the meta block (e.g. 'All members').

name: service_meta_label
label: Service Meta Label
help_text: Label text for the service name in the meta block.

name: tier_meta_label
label: Tier Meta Label
help_text: Label text for the tier value in the meta block.

name: availability_meta_label
label: Availability Meta Label
help_text: Label text for the availability value in the meta block.

name: form
label: Enquiry Form
help_text: Select the 'Service Enquiry' HubSpot form. Create it in Marketing > Forms first.

default.message: Thanks for your enquiry. We'll be in touch shortly.

name: disclaimer_text
label: Form Disclaimer Text
help_text: Small disclaimer text shown below the form submit button.
default: By submitting this form you agree to our privacy policy. We will not share your information with third parties.
